excerpt: Because dark sectors are generically weakly coupled to ordinary matter, and because they can naturally have MeV-to-GeV masses and respect the symmetries of the SM, they are only mildly constrained by high-energy collider data and precision atomic measurements.
publisher: arXiv (preprint); S. Gori, M. Williams, P. Ilten, N. Tran et al. (13 authors)
title: Dark Sector Physics at High-Intensity Experiments (Report of Topical Group RF6, Snowmass 2021)
